question: Which entities must be worshipped on the altar and on the stand?
premises: Śakti is to be worshipped on the altar
The three-principle group is to be worshipped on the stand
inference: One should worship Śakti on the altar and the three-principle group on the stand.
uncertainties: The exact composition of the three-principle group is not specified here.
plain_english: On the altar one should worship Śakti, and on the stand the group of three principles.
